description: A package under `node_modules` (`styled-pkg`) whose CommonJS entry requires its own `styles.css`, under a preset whose `transform` takes `\.css$` with a transformer the fixture carries (`css-transform.cjs`, which returns the class names as a CommonJS module) and whose `transformIgnorePatterns` lets the package through. Jest 30.5.2 runs the claiming transform on the `.css` file, whatever its text holds, so the test gets the class names. Provino loads a claimed file Node doesn't run as JavaScript as a user module, transformed and evaluated per file, where Node's own `require` of a `.css` file is a `SyntaxError`. Read by `provino`'s `transform-node-modules.test.ts`. A black-box run.
